register.labelZh: TRUST AND TRUSS 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: TRUST AND TRUSS Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: trust in 能幫助你表示自己十分相信某人、計劃、方法或系統。；trust somebody with something 表示你相信某人能安全照顧他人或妥善處理物件。；trust to luck、chance 或 fate 可以描述沒有可靠資料、援助或清晰計劃,只好碰運氣的情況。；學會 truss up 能幫助你理解烹飪指示、包裹和戲劇或電影中的綑綁場面。
register.summaryEn: Trust in helps you say that you believe deeply in a person, plan, method or system. Trust somebody with something shows that you believe a person will look after someone or handle something safely. Trust to luck, chance or fate describes acting without reliable information, help or a clear plan. Knowing truss up helps you understand cooking instructions, parcels and scenes in plays or films.
